title: Every exterior shot in *The Taking of Pelham 123*
excerpt: This is a list of the location of every exterior shot in New York City from the classic 1974 crime film The Taking of Pelham 123.
content_html:
“Is garbage so private?”

This is a list of the location of every exterior shot in New York City from the classic 1974 crime film The Taking of Pelham 123.

Most of the film, which concerns a subway hijacking, take places underground, but there are about 40 exterior shots in Manhattan. The filmmakers evidently took care to use real locations that match the action in the film (i.e., when the subway train is parked near the 28th Street station, the aboveground police field command was filmed at 28th Street and Park Avenue), with only a few continuity breaks. Despite the passage of 50 years, nearly all the exterior shots are still easily identifiable in the contemporary city.

Timestamps are from the YouTube video, which is free to watch with ads as of July 2026.

Highlights

  • 56:26–59:58 A police convoy transports the ransom money from the Federal Reserve Bank in Lower Manhattan to the field headquarters at 28th Street, passing through the Financial District, Civic Center, SoHo, and the East Village.

Comprehensive list

Entering the subway

  • 1:41 Lexington Avenue and 59th Street, facing north; Bloomingdale's department store at right (StreetView)

Subsequent interior shots in the subway are the actual Lexington and 59th Street station.

Gracie Mansion

  • 32:19 Gracie Mansion on the Upper East Side (the mayor's official residence)

FDR Drive

  • 40:08 FDR Drive just north of the Manhattan Bridge, facing south (StreetView)
  • 40:12 FDR Drive just south of the Williamsburg Bridge (StreetView)
  • 40:43 Just north of the Brooklyn Bridge, facing south (StreetView)
    • Minor continuity break: the car is heading north but this location is south of previous shots.
  • 40:51 Probably by Corlears Hook Park on the FDR Drive, facing south (StreetView)
  • 41:01 Just south of the Williamsburg Bridge on the FDR Drive, facing south (StreetView), then just north of the bridge at 41:11 (StreetView)
  • 46:18 FDR Drive around 51st Street, facing north – possibly taken from the footbridge (StreetView)

Field headquarters at 28th Street

  • 40:30 and 41:08 Park and 28th facing west (StreetView)
  • 1:02:25 Back at Park and 28th (StreetView)
  • 1:19:55 Park and 28th again, panning to a broader view of the street (StreetView)

Transporting the ransom money

  • 49:36 Interior courtyard of the Federal Reserve Bank in the Financial District
    • Labeled as such, although I don't see a courtyard or external vehicular entrance on the current building, nor can I match the building seen in the background to any of the surrounding buildings.
  • 56:26 uncertain
    • The "Italian Line" building appears to be this one at Platt and William, but I can't find a perspective that matches the shot.
  • 56:36 Pine Street and Pearl Street (StreetView)
  • 56:43 Pine Street facing west, between Pearl and William (StreetView)
  • 56:56 uncertain
  • 56:57 Nassau Street just south of Beekman Street, facing north (StreetView)
  • 57:05 Park Row at City Hall, facing west, pans north to the Manhattan Municipal Building (StreetView)
  • 57:28 Wall Street and Broad Street (StreetView)
    • Continuity break: This is well south of the previous shot.
  • 57:30 South end of Foley Square, facing north (StreetView)
    • I suspect the street has narrowed or been slightly rerouted since the 1970s as I cannot recreate the exact perspective in the shot.
  • 57:37 Centre Street and Worth Street, facing north (StreetView)
  • 58:29 Centre Street and Broome Street, facing north (StreetView)
  • 58:41 Cleveland Place just north of Kenmare Street, facing north (StreetView)
  • 58:44 Cleveland Place and Spring Street, facing south (StreetView), then at 58:57 facing north (StreetView)
  • 59:49 Lafayette Street between 4th Street and Astor Place, facing north (StreetView)
    • In the film, the policeman radios that they are crossing Houston Street, but the shot is actually a few blocks north of that: notice Colonnade Row at the immediate left.
  • 59:58 Lafayette Street at Astor Place, facing north (StreetView); later facing south at 1:00:02 (StreetView) and facing north again at 1:01:01 (StreetView)

The pursuit

  • 1:17:51 Park Avenue and 17th Street, facing south (StreetView), then facing north at 1:17:58 (StreetView)
  • 1:19:58 14th Street at the southeast corner of Union Square, facing west (StreetView)
  • 1:20:15 and again 1:21:06 Back at Park Avenue and 17th Street, facing south
  • 1:25:13 Broadway just south of 4th Street, facing north (StreetView)
  • 1:27:06 Broadway at Bond Street, initially facing north (StreetView) then turning east down Bond (StreetView)
  • 1:29:26 Astor Place again, panning north (StreetView)
  • 1:30:21 Union Square East facing west (StreetView)
  • 1:30:36 Same location, facing south and then panning north

content_html_zh:
“Is garbage so private?”

这是 1974 年经典犯罪电影《夺取佩勒姆 123》中纽约市所有外景拍摄地点的列表。

这部讲述地铁劫持事件的影片大部分发生在地下，但也有大约 40 个在曼哈顿的外景镜头。 电影制作者显然很注意使用与电影中的动作相匹配的真实地点（即，当地铁列车停在第 28 街车站附近时，地上警察现场指挥是在第 28 街和公园大道拍摄的），只有几个连续性中断。 尽管已经过去了 50 年，几乎所有的外景镜头在当代城市中仍然很容易辨认。

时间戳来自 YouTube 视频，截至 2026 年 7 月，该视频可免费观看并带有广告。

亮点

  • 56:26–59:58 警察车队将赎金从曼哈顿下城的联邦储备银行运送到 28 街的战地总部，途经金融区、市政中心、SoHo 和东村。

综合清单

进入地铁

  • 1:41 Lexington Avenue 和 59th Street，朝北；右侧是布鲁明代尔百货公司（街景）

随后的地铁内部镜头是实际的列克星敦站和第 59 街站。

格雷西大厦

  • 32:19 上东区格雷西大厦（市长官邸）

罗斯福驱动器

  • 40:08 FDR Drive 位于曼哈顿大桥以北，朝南（街景）
  • 40:12 FDR Drive 位于威廉斯堡大桥以南（街景）
  • 40:43 就在布鲁克林大桥以北，朝南（街景） 轻微的连续性中断：汽车向北行驶，但该位置位于之前镜头的南边。
  • 40:51 可能位于 FDR 大道上的 Corlears Hook 公园，朝南（街景）
  • 41:01 位于罗斯福大道威廉斯堡大桥以南，面朝南（街景），然后于 41:11 位于桥北（街景）
  • 46:18 FDR 沿着 51 街行驶，朝北 – 可能是从人行天桥拍摄的（街景）

28 街战地指挥部

  • 40:30 和 41:08 公园和 28 号朝西（街景）
  • 1:02:25 回到公园和 28 号（街景）
  • 1:19:55 再次进入 28 号公园，平移至更广阔的街道视野 (StreetView)

运送赎金

  • 49:36 金融区联邦储备银行的内部庭院 贴上这样的标签，尽管我在当前建筑物上没有看到庭院或外部车辆入口，也无法将背景中看到的建筑物与周围的任何建筑物相匹配。
  • 56:26 不确定 “意大利线”建筑似乎是普拉特和威廉的这座建筑，但我找不到与镜头相匹配的视角。
  • 56:36 松树街和珍珠街（街景）
  • 56:43 Pine Street 朝西，位于 Pearl 和 William 之间（街景）
  • 56:56 不确定
  • 56:57 Nassau 街位于 Beekman 街以南，朝北（街景）
  • 57:05 市政厅公园街，朝西，向北平移到曼哈顿市政大楼（街景）
  • 57:28 华尔街和布罗德街（街景） 连续性中断：这位于上一个镜头的南边。
  • 57:30 弗利广场南端，朝北（街景） 我怀疑街道自 20 世纪 70 年代以来已经变窄或稍微改变了路线，因为我无法在镜头中重现准确的视角。
  • 57:37 中心街和沃斯街，朝北（街景）
  • 58:29 中心街和布鲁姆街，朝北（街景）
  • 58:41 克利夫兰广场 (Cleveland Place) 位于肯梅尔街 (Kenmare Street) 以北，朝北 (街景)
  • 58:44 Cleveland Place 和 Spring Street，朝南（StreetView），然后在 58:57 朝北（StreetView）
  • 59:49 拉斐特街，位于第 4 街和阿斯特广场之间，朝北（街景） 在影片中，警察用无线电报告他们正在穿过休斯顿街，但镜头实际上是在该街以北几个街区处：注意左侧的柱廊街。
  • 59:58 位于 Astor Place 的 Lafayette 街，朝北（街景）；随后在 1:00:02 (StreetView) 朝南，并在 1:01:01 (StreetView) 再次朝北

  • 1:30:36 同一位置，面向南，然后向北平移
